\r\n

If you still have your mail-in ballot, you can still drop off your ballot at an in-person voting or designated drop box location.

\r\n

Voting and drop box locations are designated throughout the county and are found by visiting Locations.Maricopa.Vote or calling 602-506-1511. Hours of operation may vary by location. On Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026, designated voting and drop box locations will be open to voters from 6:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.

\r\n

Make sure you and everyone you know is #BallotReady!

\r\n
For more information about the upcoming election, visit Phoenix.gov/Elections, call 602-261-VOTE (8683), email phoenixelections@phoenix.gov or follow on X @PHXClerk.

Voting and drop box locations are designated throughout the county and are found by visiting Locations.Maricopa.Vote or calling 602-506-1511. Hours of operation may vary by location. On Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026, designated voting and drop box locations will be open to voters from 6:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Make sure you and everyone you know is #BallotReady!
